outbreak_frequency: 2011-2012 typhoid epidemic was the 4th enteric-infection epidemic since 2008 in Harare; Harare also had a typhoid epidemic in 2010, and cholera epidemics in 2008, 2009, 2010
endemicity: Inverse age-risk gradient observed, described as "typical of typhoid-endemic areas"; sub-Saharan Africa described as region with greatest global typhoid incidence
notes: Recurrence attributed to chronic underinvestment in water/sanitation infrastructure, irregular water supply, breakdown of sanitation, borehole contamination; no TCV mention
